questions.stem_text:
Which of the following best describes the practice of placing the blame for the problems
of a society on one particular group?

The population pyramid of a population that has had a slightly larger birth rate than
death rate for several generations will most likely have which of the following shapes?

options.A: Wider at the top than in the middle
options.B: Wider at the bottom than at the top

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Wider at the bottom than at the top

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is the most important agent of socialization in early childhood?
The work of Smart suggested that:

options.A: the rates of violent crime were similar for men and women
options.B: women's sexual delinquency was more likely to be normalized than men's
options.C: women's criminal behaviour tended to reflect traditional gender roles

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - women's criminal behaviour tended to reflect traditional gender roles

questions.stem_text: It is difficult to ascertain the true extent of domestic violence because:

options.A: there is a large 'dark figure' of unreported incidents
options.B: the changing definitions of legal categories have made it harder to convict offenders
options.C: researchers are not allowed access to official statistics
options.D: there is no valid or reliable way of researching such a sensitive topic

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - there is a large 'dark figure' of unreported incidents
